summary: The university has announced its tuition payment plan for Fall 2026, with details in the attached documents. Students should consult the attachments, including the English payment guide, for the payment schedule and procedures. The notice text gives no payment dates, location or method; these are only in the attachments or an image, which were not read.
applies_to: The notice text does not state who must act. The attachment titles refer to currently enrolled students (재학생) and to students who have exceeded the standard number of semesters (규정학기초과자).
conditions: The title of Attachment 3 states that third-party proxy payment and unauthorised services (private payment, currency exchange and remittance agents) must not be used to pay tuition; the attachment itself was not read.
The payment schedule the notice refers to ("below") does not appear in the notice text; it may be in an image or attachment, which was not read.
steps: Read the English tuition payment guide for enrolled students ([붙임1-2] 2026-2 재학생 등록금 납부 안내문_영문.pdf) attached to the original notice, and find the payment schedule.
Read the tuition payment FAQ ([붙임2] 2026-2 등록금 납부 FAQ.pdf).
Read Attachment 3 on the prohibition of third-party proxy payment and unauthorised payment, exchange and remittance services.
Check your tuition amount in the Fall 2026 tuition table ([붙임4]) or, if you have exceeded the standard number of semesters, in the tuition table for such students ([붙임5]).
Pay your tuition within the period and by the method given in the attachments. For questions, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Title: Fall 2026 Tuition Payment Plan

We are announcing the tuition payment plan for the second semester of the 2026 academic year (Fall 2026) as attached. Please refer to the tuition payment schedule below.

[Translator's note: The payment schedule referred to as "below" does not appear in the notice text. It may be in an image or in the attachments, which were not read.]

Attachments (6)

[Attachment 1-1] 2026-2 Tuition Payment Guide for Enrolled Students, Korean (2026-2 재학생 등록금 납부 안내문_국문.pdf, 251 KB)

[Attachment 1-2] 2026-2 Tuition Payment Guide for Enrolled Students, English (2026-2 재학생 등록금 납부 안내문_영문.pdf, 217 KB)

[Attachment 2] 2026-2 Tuition Payment FAQ (2026-2 등록금 납부 FAQ.pdf, 208 KB)

[Attachment 3] Notice on the Prohibition of Third-Party Proxy Payment and of Unauthorised Services such as Private Payment, Currency Exchange and Remittance Agents When Paying Tuition (등록금 납부 시 제3자 대리납부 및 사설 결제·환전·송금대행 등 비인가 서비스 이용 금지 안내.pdf, 1 MB)

[Attachment 4] Fall 2026 Tuition Table for Undergraduate and Graduate Students (2026학년도 제2학기 대학(원)생 등록금 일람표.pdf, 66 KB)

[Attachment 5] 2026 Tuition Table for Students Who Have Exceeded the Standard Number of Semesters (2026학년도 규정학기초과자 등록금 일람표.pdf, 97 KB)

[Translator's note: The contents of the attachments were not read.]
attachments: [붙임3] 등록금 납부 시 제3자 대리납부 및 사설 결제·환전·송금대행 등 비인가 서비스 이용 금지 안내.pdf
